workflow_description: Reads state and job-category search URLs from Google Sheets, fetches Glassdoor job listings with the ScrapeHero community node, splits the job_details array, parses estimated_salary into numeric minimum and maximum values, and appends one historical observation per job listing.
business_benefits: Build a dated record of Glassdoor salary estimates by job listing.
Compare compensation ranges across job categories and states.
Preserve hourly and annual pay periods instead of mixing unlike amounts.
Keep job ID and observation time together to review changes over time.
Reduce repetitive job-board checks with scheduled API queries.
